name: Hopsprout
look: a cheerful cone of overlapping green hop bracts with a smiling face, leafy arms and a curling bine on top
entry: Brewers prize Hopsprout for the bitter, floral oils on its petals. When frightened, it releases a musky scent that puts predators to sleep.
how: Wild: common in the Liquor Meadows (an overworld biome added by CobbleEffort: Kanto 0.8.0).
Its ability Aromatic Harvest heals it and its allies a little every turn in sun or rain.
